types: Pinning (Stopping robots from moving so they couldn't aim)
Blocking (Getting in their way preventing motion across zones)
defense.comments: All three robots were trying to defend them at some point or another. The curved bumpers and great driver allow for some great jukes when defense is played in neutral. Defense in alliance zone is useless, their turret is so good, though pinning them does work well when they drive into a corner for fuel shooting since they get blocked from their fuel reserves for a bit. They are tall and do get blocked a lot under mid defense

qual.comments: Such an incredible shooter even under defense. T throughout on another level
